purpose: Reusable world-building, frame-breaking, and world-object art for Meikku interfaces and web pages

frame_breakers.role: oversized composition art that may cross a section boundary behind information

assets.role: dominant organic material field behind or beside one hero actor
one crossing trajectory that connects idea, trial, correction, and return
grounded edge motif behind the information plane
sparse background punctuation using clay tools, token, and material objects

objects.role: the Meikku world-object family: flat pigment item illustrations with slate keylines, equivalent to a game site's power-up / item icon library; use at 48-160px on paper or clay fields

frames.role: conversation bubbles and content frames; text and imagery are supplied by the consuming layout, never baked into the asset

assets.role: spoken line, tail lower-left; either participant may use either side
spoken line, tail lower-right
an offered idea not yet chosen; dashed = candidate per effect language
workshop notice pinned with tape; announcements and tips
evidence window with a solid claim-label tab; pair with LIVE / SIMULATED / CORE text in the tab
light corner containment for imagery that should not get a full border

stamps.role: rubber-stamp claim labels and ritual marks; the word carries the meaning, pigment is reinforcement only

assets.role: token value mark for arcade/admission surfaces
memory kept / correction accepted mark
identity seal derived from the official mark's ray grammar; not a replacement logo

banners.role: section headers, titles, and navigation patches; consuming layout sets the type

buttons.role: button plate art for four states; keep labels 16-20px Bungee in the consuming layer; hover/pressed pigment shown here is a local example

containers.role: world-material media frames: Splatoon frames media in ink, Meikku frames it in clay, coil, torn zine paper, pigment stroke, token teeth, rays, workbench grid, and tape; media windows only — controls and evidence stay rectangular
containers.viewbox: 480x360, uniform ~72-unit band, transparent window, CSS border-image friendly

assets.role: pigment declared locally per artifact

controls.role: control-plate art for mockups and styling reference; runtime surfaces implement native controls styled to match; state is geometry (solid vs outline, closed shadow, dashed), never color alone

dividers.role: world-object section dividers extending the four v1 dividers

assets.role: wavy entry edge into a clay field; overlap the previous section
wavy exit edge out of a clay field (stroke on the wave only); also usable as an alpha mask to end a colored band organically

patterns.role: seamless ambient tiles extending the six v1 patterns; keep at 0.10-0.20 effective presence behind content

meters.role: progress and turn-economy art; values shown are static art, never fake runtime data

scene_edges.role: footer scenes, shelf strips, and paired side flanks that ground a page in the shared-table world; always behind information

assets.role: page footer scene: hand and gripper converge on one vessel across the table horizon
top or band strip of workshop objects on a shelf line
left page-margin punctuation; pair with flank-tools-right
right page-margin punctuation

layer_order: person + verified SO-101 + clay actor cluster
hard-contained headings, body copy, cards, evidence, and claim labels
functional controls above all non-interactive art
never: copy Nintendo characters, logos, scenery, or Animal Island source artwork
apply v2 frame-breakers to the opening #frame-01 hero in ui/meikku_world.html
apply v2 frame-breakers across the #after to #press-start closing boundary
clip an oversized decorative asset at a section edge or viewport edge
give decoration the same or higher z-index than information
attach decorative pseudo-elements to cards where they can paint over copy or imagery
turn every panel into an irregular shape
let art obscure controls, claim labels, evidence captions, or stop states
present Core scene art as Demo runtime evidence
bake live-sounding numbers into meter art or stamp a claim label the surface cannot prove

typography_note: Stamp and seal text uses Bungee with an Arial Black fallback embedded as SVG text. Inside pages that load Bungee the stamps render exactly; standalone contexts degrade to the approved heavy block fallback.

routing.core: full stage, photographic actor cluster, and richer depth cues behind the information plane; scene edges and objects may build the world freely
routing.demo: rectangular evidence window plus one lightweight background frame-breaker; stamps carry the claim vocabulary
routing.web: SVG assets as img, mask, or background layers; patterns via background-repeat
routing.unity: rasterize objects at 64/128 and scene edges at target resolution; keep runtime controls native
routing.exhibition: shared-table ridge, footer scene, and sparse objects behind or outside the proof surface
